steps.content: Every fissure seals shut. The purple rifts close one by one, and the puppets' shrieks slowly fade into the distance.
Slowly, Lemma drags herself up, disheveled and coated in dust. Her hand is still clamped tight on the terminal button.

steps.speaker: Lemma
steps.content: I told you! I knew it would work! ${PlayerName}, look!
Before you can respond, a mass of twisted shadow begins to coalesce behind her out of nowhere.
The already lifeless puppet remains crumple inward, as if crushed by invisible hands, and where their abdomens were, a new fissure is slowly opening.
Unlike any of the dimensional fissures before it, this one appears darker, much more viscous; its edges seem to bleed, and it exudes a sickening Mania aura.
The secret channel, silent until now, suddenly reconnects, and an urgent shout cuts through.
She turns, and the sight seizes her utterly still.

The creature forcing its way out of the fissure is impossibly massive, nearly filling the entire passage. Its body is a grotesque patchwork of countless puppet remains stitched together, every piece still writhing.

You release the shackles. In the dense Mania-saturated air, your power flares to blinding intensity, yet it does nothing to stop this abomination. All you can do is throw yourself toward the scientist and shove her aside.
A searing pain rips through you. You never see the puppet move. Instead, that vile fissure seizes hold of you, dragging, tearing, until it devours you like some unseen, gaping maw.
Her frantic voice fades further and further away. The void beyond the fissure has swallowed you whole.
